strategies.name: Detection of Exploitation of Remote Services

analytics.name: Analytic 1755
analytics.guidance: Defender observes a mobile device initiating abnormal or exploit-like network interactions with internal or remote services, followed by process-level instability, privilege boundary shifts, or unexpected execution behaviors indicative of service exploitation outcomes.

tuning.description: Defines deviation tolerance for malformed or exploit-like protocol behavior
Temporal linkage between suspicious network activity and process instability
Environment-specific baseline of expected internal service communications

log_sources.name: NSM:Connections
log_sources.channel: Outbound connections to internal enterprise services exhibiting anomalous protocol behavior, malformed sessions, or exploit-consistent traffic patterns

log_sources.name: AndroidLogs:Crash
log_sources.channel: Application or system process crash/restart patterns temporally associated with remote service communications

analytics.name: Analytic 1756
analytics.guidance: Defender observes a mobile device engaging remote or internal services with traffic characteristics inconsistent with normal application behavior, followed by execution anomalies, application instability, or security context deviations consistent with exploitation effects.

tuning.description: Defines acceptable protocol and payload variation

log_sources.name: NSM:Connections
log_sources.channel: Outbound connections to internal enterprise services exhibiting anomalous protocol behavior, malformed sessions, or exploit-consistent traffic patterns

log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Application crash logs, watchdog terminations, or abnormal execution events associated with service communication
